question: Which of the following is a private good?

options.text: A good that is consumed by a single person or household
A good that is available to everyone to consume, regardless of who pays for it and who does not.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A good that is consumed by a single person or household**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A good that is consumed by a single person or household is a private good**__. 

 
 
• A public good is a product that one individual can consume without reducing its availability to others and from which no one is excluded.
 
• A private good is the opposite of a public good.
 
• A private good is a product that must be purchased to be consumed, and consumption by one individual prevents another individual from consuming it.
 
• We encounter private goods every day. For example- dinner at a restaurant, grocery shopping, airplane rides, and cellphones.
 
• Any item that is effectively destroyed or rendered unusable for its original purpose through use, such as food and toilet paper, are also private good.
